name: Life steal
effect: Heals for the value in percent of the damage dealt by each hit

name: Fire affinity
effect: Raises fire spell damage by the value in percent

name: Frost affinity
effect: Raises frost spell damage by the value in percent

name: Regeneration
effect: Restores the value in percent of maximum health every 10 seconds

name: Thick hide
effect: Raises defence by the value in percent (physical, cannot be absorbed)

name: Keen fangs
effect: Raises critical chance by the value in percentage points (physical, cannot be absorbed)
